sources.title: 2020 economic sciences prize announcement
sources.findings: October 12, 2020 shared award with Paul Milgrom; common-value auctions and winner’s curse; born 1937 Geneva USA, Harvard DBA1963, Stanford emeritus.
sources.caution: Not 1978 physics winner or theatre director. Theory does not promise every auction is efficient or every winner loses.

sources.title: CV dated June 1997
sources.findings: Harvard AB1959 MBA1961 DBA1963; Stanford1964; Sequential Equilibria with David Kreps July1982; Nonlinear Pricing1993.
sources.caution: Historical CV title not current role; DBA not economics PhD; honorary degrees separate.

sources.title: Nonlinear Pricing
sources.findings: March25,1993 book; pricing not strictly proportional to quantity; published with Electric Power Research Institute.
sources.caution: Metadata and abstract read, not full book; not invention of every nonlinear tariff.

sources.title: Distinguished Fellow 2006
sources.findings: Sequential equilibrium with Kreps; FCC auction design with Milgrom and Preston McAfee; electricity markets and pricing.
sources.caution: Sequential equilibrium refines choices; not a guarantee of unique equilibrium in every game.

sources.title: 1997 report to Congress on spectrum auctions
sources.findings: First simultaneous multiple-round FCC auction commenced July25,1994.
sources.caution: Report released1997 about1994 event; joint regulatory and researcher work, not Wilson sole invention or personal auction revenue.
